findings.detail: X06 is firing on unfunded/undrawn commitment rows where principal amount is expected to exceed near-zero or negative fair value.

rationale: The checked source rows show Undrawn first-lien investments with disclosed principal/commitment amounts such as 611, 609, and 438 (thousand) and fair values of about (2), (3), or (2). The extracted principal amount therefore matches the raw schedule; the high principal-to-fair-value ratio is a normal unfunded commitment presentation, so the X06 scale/FX error check is mis-scoped rather than identifying a data defect.
